ratings.scale: Subjective holistic scores for observed emulated mobile interaction: 0 unusable, 5 playable with substantial friction, 7 good with clear friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional. Wins and HUD scores are not quality grades. Overall is a judgment, not a numerical average.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, completable mission with helpful touch assistance and atmospheric presentation; repeated manual patrol tracking failures materially limit confidence in mobile combat.
reasons.controls: Large labeled controls, touch aim, scene swipe and reload all acted visibly. Simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag repeatedly lost target and opening bursts reported COVER/NO IMPACT; this is observed friction, not a proven implementation defect. Continuous rearming is unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coils-to-upload provides clear progression. Coil vulnerability and OFF feedback were satisfying to understand. Mostly assisted travel and brief combat do not establish sustained challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber visual language, rain, lit station and restrained terminal panel communicate atmosphere; software rendering limits visual fidelity judgment.
reasons.usability: Objective labels, route/approach affordances, progress slots, threat direction and upload instruction helped completion. Reload required an extra tray step; map overview was understandable but small.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and key objective text clear; smaller signs, compact map, dark enemies and multiple overlapping HUD regions made tracking harder.

coverage.manualMoveFireDrag: Opening guard twice and visible perimeter patrol once; simultaneous left MOVE and right FIRE drag. COVER then NO IMPACT at guard; patrol target left view; no confirmed manual patrol hit or kill. Ammo spent; corrections did not establish success.
coverage.sceneTurn: Scene swipe changed heading 081 to 127; visible TURN threat cue also sampled.
coverage.boss: Reload via TOOLS; targeted coil bursts visibly disabled III, II, I.
coverage.assistance: Held visible ROUTE/APPROACH to collect three memories and reach uplink.

helpful: Clear saved-memory banners and numbered progress
Distinct OPEN/ARMORED and OFF coil feedback
frustrating: Guard shots reported COVER / NO IMPACT
Tap and FIRE drag moved patrol outside view; uncertain hits
attempts.protocolDeviation: Initial deployment used an act tap at visible ENTER THE STORM coordinates with capture instead of selector #deploy. It started the first mission; no restart or extra attempt.

attempts.freshStart: act tap #play-again and capture from attempt-one end screen

coverage.openingGuard: Stationary scene tap then anchored FIRE: visible TARGET DOWN. This is assisted aiming, not manual drag success.
coverage.manualMoveFireDrag: Visible SENTINEL CHARGING patrol: scene tap, simultaneous left MOVE and small right FIRE drag; ammo 21 to 18, shield 60 to 41, heading 299 to 273 and target no longer visible. No confirmed hit or kill. Preserved failed tracking; no causal diagnosis.
coverage.sceneTurn: Visible TURN CHARGE cue sampled; scene swipe specifically sampled in attempt one, not repeated here.
coverage.planningMap: Opened MAP; inspected overview, selected Mara, 26m route and legend; closed with visible #close-map. No route selection changed.
coverage.tools: Opened TOOLS and selected visible RELOAD in same batch; ammo 6 to 30.
coverage.boss: Targeted bursts at visible OPEN coils II, I, III; individual OFF markers then RETURN TO DECK.
coverage.assistance: ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER holds for three memories, coil position and deck; stayed for upload.

helpful: Planning map explicitly showed selected receiver and walking distance
Coil OFF markers and changing objective confirmed progress
Upload percentage and STAY ON DECK made completion legible
frustrating: Charging patrol again escaped manual tracking and dealt shield damage
Map drawing small relative to large selection controls
Dense HUD and dark architecture compete with small moving targets
uncertainties: Displayed 100% accuracy is recorded verbatim; it does not confirm my manual patrol drag hit or explain aggregate accounting
No continuous combat comfort inference from released short batches

next: Fresh independent portrait mobile reviewer on identical frozen source; no app, dossier or snapshot edits between reviews.
